# Disclaimer: This function was generated by AI. Please review before using.
# Agent Name: data_wrangling_agent
# Time Created: 2026-10-29 21:14:44

def data_wrangler(data_list):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    '''
    Wrangle the data provided in data_list.
    
    data_list: A list of one or more pandas data frames containing the raw data to be wrangled.
    '''


    # Ensure data_list is a list (handle single DataFrame case)
    if not isinstance(data_list, list):
        data_list = [data_list]
    
    # Combine all data frames into one if there are multiple
    if len(data_list) > 1:
        data = pd.concat(data_list, ignore_index=True)
    else:
        data = data_list[0]
    
    # Count missing values in the 'sales' column
    missing_sales_count = data['sales'].isnull().sum()
    
    # Return a single-cell table with the count of missing values in the 'sales' column
    result_df = pd.DataFrame({'missing_sales_count': [missing_sales_count]})
    
    return result_df
